Name: Ostrich Incubator - Free and Renamed
Author: jenf1
Description:
Have a hundred million animals that can be hatched inside a barn? Don't want to wait to unlock Ginger Island to unlock the needed incubator?

This mod renames the Ostrich Incubator to Large Egg Incubator, and adds a free, indestructible one to the Big Barn.

Note: Due to game limitations, the Large Egg Incubator will not appear in Big Barns built before this mod was installed. You can get around this by spawning one in with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url].


Install:

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
- Copy [CP] Ostrich Incubator Free and Renamed into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!
